issues.source_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
issues.reason: The query reports a violation only when a case displacement is greater than DUI. It does not report a violation when DUI is greater than every case displacement, even though the source requires DUI to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest displacement. Thus the implemented condition is one-sided and does not enforce equality to the maximum numeric displacement.
issues.expected: The active constraint must require DUI to equal the greatest applicable waterline-case displacement, using numeric-value comparison in the declared unit. Both a DUI below the maximum and a DUI above the maximum must be rejected.
issues.suggestion: Retain the metric-kilotonne and decimal quantity checks, and change the aggregate logic so that there is no case with numericValue greater than DUI and at least one determining case whose numericValue equals DUI, or otherwise express an equivalent maximum/equality condition. Do not compare quantity RDF terms directly.
